key_insight: AI-Donkey combines expert-curated knowledge with deterministic execution to make LLM-driven many-body perturbation theory workflows reliable in the reported tests.
engineering_relevance: The framework could reduce specialist setup effort for calculating excited-state properties and particle interactions across 1D, 2D, and bulk materials.
method: Benchmark unassisted LLM agents on GW, GW-BSE, and GWPT workflow construction.
Integrate expert-curated knowledge and deterministic execution through AI-Donkey.
Demonstrate autonomous calculations and post-processing, including many-body enhancement of Fröhlich electron-phonon coupling.
evidence_signal: Out-of-the-box agents averaged 54%, 36%, and 19% on GW, GW-BSE, and GWPT benchmarks, respectively; with AI-Donkey, all tested agents produced complete, runnable workflows with no observed run-to-run variation.
watch_item: Runnable workflows do not alone establish physical accuracy or convergence; reliability beyond the tested cases and curated knowledge remains to be demonstrated.
paper_title: Enabling large language model agents for high-fidelity many-body perturbation theory calculations
